spec.title: Stopwatch
spec.description: A simple stopwatch with tenths, start, stop, reset and lap times.

children.text: Tap Lap while the stopwatch runs.

ui: {"type": "theme", "preset": "technical", "cornerRadius": 22, "children": [{"type": "column", "style": {"gap": "medium", "padding": "medium"}, "children": [{"type": "card", "children": [{"type": "row", "wrap": false, "style": {"gap": "small", "crossAlign": "center"}, "children": [{"type": "column", "style": {"gap": "small"}, "layout": {"weight": 1}, "children": [{"type": "metric", "text": "Elapsed", "bind": "elapsedText", "style": {"emphasis": "number"}}, {"type": "text", "text": "Status", "bind": "statusText", "style": {"tone": "muted"}}]}, {"type": "canvas", "text": "Running indicator", "surfaces": ["ticker"], "layout": {"width": 64, "height": 64}}]}]}, {"type": "row", "wrap": true, "style": {"gap": "small"}, "children": [{"type": "button", "text": "Start", "action": "start", "variant": "filled", "visibleBind": "notRunning"}, {"type": "button", "text": "Stop", "action": "stop", "variant": "tonal", "visibleBind": "running"}, {"type": "button", "text": "Lap", "action": "lap", "variant": "outlined", "visibleBind": "running"}, {"type": "button", "text": "Reset", "action": "reset", "variant": "text", "enabledBind": "canReset"}]}, {"type": "metric", "text": "Laps recorded", "bind": "lapCountText"}, {"type": "emptyState", "text": "No laps yet", "visibleBind": "noLaps", "children": [{"type": "text", "text": "Tap Lap while the stopwatch runs.", "style": {"tone": "muted"}}]}, {"type": "list", "text": "Laps", "bind": "laps", "visibleBind": "hasLaps", "columns": [{"text": "Lap", "field": "name"}, {"text": "Split", "field": "split"}, {"text": "Total", "field": "total"}]}]}]}
